name: Cotswold Stonemasons
_formerName_note: The business traded as Jackson's Stonemasonry Ltd until November 2026. Kept as alternateName in the structured data so Google links old reviews and mentions to the new name.
_url_note: Live site URL. Canonical URLs, the sitemap and structured data are generated from this. The business now owns cotswoldstonemasons.com: once it is attached in Netlify and loads the site, change this value to https://cotswoldstonemasons.com (and add a redirect from the old domain).
tagline: Traditional Stonemasonry & Dry Stone Walling in the Cotswolds
description: Traditional stonemasons in Winchcombe, near Cheltenham. Dry stone walling, stone restoration, stone cleaning, stone carving and stone wall repair across Gloucestershire and the Cotswolds.
_googleSiteVerification_note: Token from Google Search Console → Add property → URL prefix → HTML tag. Paste only the content value here, not the whole tag. Once verified it must stay in place, or Google drops the verification.
_gbp_note: Add the Google Business Profile / Google Maps short link here once claimed — it is used for 'Read our Google reviews' links.

map._note: Coverage-map projection. Add lat/lon to a location file and it appears on the map automatically.
